name: Munea: Family Care Companion
subtitle: AI voice chat & pill reminders
promotionalText: Parent living alone? Nina is there to talk anytime and reminds them about medicine and doctor's appointments. Family you invite can see how they're doing in the app.
description:
Munea is an AI companion that lives on your iPhone.

Just talk out loud with your companion about your day, your interests, and your memories. With your permission, Munea can save short summaries of your conversations, so the next chat picks up where you left off.

Key features:
• Voice chat: talk and listen as naturally as on a phone call
• Reminders: set reminders for medicine, doctor's appointments, and everyday tasks
• Family: invite family into your family circle, pass along messages, and join activities together
• Mood and health records: look back at the daily-life and health info you've chosen to save
• Apple Health: with your permission, Munea reads supported health data

Munea is a companionship and daily-reminder tool. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, psychotherapy, or emergency services. If you feel unwell, see a qualified healthcare professional. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.

Some voice and AI features use credits. Prices, renewal and cancellation terms, the credits included each period, and the terms for purchased credits are shown clearly in the app and on Apple's purchase screen.
whatsNew: More reliable calls: fixed a problem where, after one call, leaving the app and coming back meant the next call wouldn't connect. Nina now says hello first when the call connects, the app no longer flashes the logo twice when it opens, and you can set what you'd like the AI to call you in your profile.
